screening_purpose: Find licensed unedited material where one visible motif develops through at least three readable states without reset.

candidates.title: Coffee maker making coffee

observations: The sequence changes from grinder detail to portafilter close-up, wider tamping, machine spout, and glass.
Camera angle, scale, and framing change several times inside the downloaded asset.
direct_visual_review.inference: The asset is an already edited stock montage, not an unedited source take.

rejection_reasons: It violates the unedited-source proof requirement.
Existing editorial decisions would be mistaken for Haku Tool decisions.

candidates.title: Woman eats ramen and snaps a selfie

observations: The woman lifts and eats noodles, lowers her hand, looks at a phone, then poses for a selfie.
The frame and performer remain continuous.
direct_visual_review.inference: This is a strong action-spine source, but the dominant logic is sequential behavior rather than one motif returning in developed states.

candidates.possible_other_use: A separate action-as-edit-spine or experience-before-product test.

candidates.title: Latte art

direct_visual_review.evidence: Complete 120-sample dense sheet covering 0.000-33.717 seconds at approximately 3.53 fps.
observations: A fixed overhead composition keeps the same cup and pouring action visible throughout.
The cup changes from dark coffee to first white contrast, broad swirl, recognizable pattern, refined rings, and a final completed surface.
The material state develops monotonically; it never returns to an earlier coffee pattern.
direct_visual_review.inference: The take provides at least five readable states of one persistent motif and can test state-return logic outside nature and relationship footage.

selection_reasons: At least five visibly different states of the same motif.
Stable cup position makes authored temporal jumps legible as state progression rather than camera lurch.
